zh.name: AI 手记
zh.intro: 我相信技术最好的样子，是为人所用、也能被人理解。这里记下我在 AI 时代亲手做的事、还没想通的事，以及想过之后仍然选择去做的理由。
zh.tagline: 在代码与人文相交的地方，我仍想亲手做点什么。

en.name: AI Notes
en.intro: I believe technology is at its best when it serves people and can be understood by them. These are notes on what I make by hand in the AI era, what I haven't figured out yet, and why I keep making things anyway.
en.tagline: Where code meets the humanities, I still want to make things by hand.

zh.title: 仍然是一个亲手创造东西的人
zh.summary: 2026 年的 AI 手记：创造的成本、Demo 与交付、个人与组织效率、经验与人才，以及自己究竟想做什么。

en.title: Still Someone Who Builds Things by Hand
en.summary: Notes on AI in 2026: the cost of creating, demos vs. delivery, individual vs. organizational speed, experience and talent, and what I really want to do.

zh.title: 我理解的“AI 时代虚无主义”
zh.summary: 从《博德之门3》的修改器说起：当 AI 让创造变得廉价，我们究竟热爱创造，还是热爱自己比别人更擅长创造？
